results.title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
results.overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

results.title: Home, Almost
results.overview: A story about an MMA fighter who finds himself in another fight on the way home. — with his father and younger brother by his side, finding the true meaning of family along the way.

results.title: Method
results.overview: After watching grief transform her classmate into a brilliant actor, an ambitious student wonders what she’s missing. "Method" is a darkly funny satire about jealousy, grief, and how far artists will go for authenticity.

results.title: Sunshine
results.overview: An adult man trapped in a state of early adolescence due to his heavily overbearing mother, must defy the rules he has known all his life in order to break free from her authoritative influence.

results.title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt
results.original_title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt
results.overview: Follows the story of the groundbreaking Texas-based art-punk band founded by frontman Gibby Haynes and guitarist Paul Leary.

results.title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle
results.original_title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle
results.overview: When a ghost hunter show comes to town, it's up to Gethsemane and Eamon to solve the unexpected murder of the host, allowing the brand-new spirit to cross-over.

results.title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 1
results.original_title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 1
results.overview: The first night of Road to The New Beginning 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on January 19, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, marking the opening of the 2026 Young Lion Cup and featuring two first-round matches of the tournament. The show was headlined by Taichi & Tomohiro Ishii vs. RoughStorm (Shota Umino & Yuya Uemura) in an IWGP Tag Team Title #1 Contendership Match.

results.title: Bótharín
results.overview: With his beloved older sister in the throws of Alzheimer's and on her deathbed, an elderly man pieces together an uncertain truth which tosses their whole relationship into question.

results.title: The Trumpeter and the Ghost
results.overview: A frustrated jazz trumpeter rehearsing for an audition accidentally awakens an invisible ghost with the power to manipulate sound. The ghost promises to turn him into a virtuoso in exchange for his help unearthing an ancient treasure buried deep in the mountains. But what begins as a great deal soon becomes a dangerous adventure leading toward a dark secret.

results.title: Graamaayana
results.overview: In a rustic village, young Seena earns his "Sixth Sense" nickname through remarkable intuition. His journey through community conflicts, romantic entanglements, and family bonds reveals the essence of rural existence.

results.title: Marave
results.overview: It follows Manolo, a gentle, naive fairground worker. When their father gets sick, Manolo reunites with his older brother Georges, a con man who abandoned the family twenty years ago. Desperate to prove he is not a failure, Georges schemes to turn the physically strong Manolo into an MMA (Mixed Martial Arts) champion.

results.title: Body Of Nurses
results.overview: A doctor is led into a web of betrayal by his nurses on a fateful night shift at a mysterious hospital.

results.title: Die Die Delta Pi II: The Burnt One
results.original_title: Die Die Delta Pi II: The Burnt One
results.overview: Thirteen years after the last Delta Pi massacre a new group of sorority sisters decide to get the Delta Pi sorority up and running again. Little do they know that a new killer has emerged taking out the sisters one by one. Will they survive? Or will this massacre be the worst one yet???

results.title: Un hombre por semana
results.overview: A divorced woman reconstructs her life and opens herself to love. Her search for dating apps takes her through fun and unpredictable moments to discover self-love.

results.title: Sai: Disaster
results.overview: Four people lead ordinary lives in different places, their paths never crossing. A mysterious man appears in each story, always as someone else. One moment, a cram school instructor; the next, a truck driver, a barber; his identity constantly shifting. Then, death strikes. A detective pursues the truth, closing in on a revelation.

results.title: Sole Survivor of Flight 119
results.overview: After surviving a devastating plane crash deep in the Mexican jungle, sole survivor Lisa Foster must rely on her resourcefulness, inner strength and faith to endure the unforgiving wilderness and find her way home to her young daughter.

results.title: The Decisive Moment
results.overview: In the future, three Chinese astronauts, on their way back to Earth, encountered a complicated situation and lost contact with the ground. At the moment of crisis, they received an electronic signal, and their destiny will be completely changed by a mysterious code hidden in this signal.
